description: TEST FIXTURE for script_drilldown (2026-09-20). Drilldown ON: untrusted -File scripts are opened, split into statements, and classified as if typed on the command line. Run via test/config/script-drilldown/Run-Tests.ps1.
_comment_trusted_programs: Basename form - matches the script anywhere. trusted.ps1 is the D9 short-circuit target (never read when drilldown is ON).
